title: Work & Getting Things Done - Munka és igekötők
grammar: review job/workplace vocabulary and verb prefixes (be-, ki-, fel-, le-, el-, meg-)

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can talk about my job, where I work, and my workday, using possessive suffixes and cases.
I can use verb prefixes like be-, ki-, fel-, le-, el- and meg- to describe everyday actions, including in the negative.
